10.en: They applied for a mortgage to buy their first home.
10.zh: 他们申请了房屋抵押贷款，准备买第一套房。

14.en: The recent surge in rent has made it hard for students to find a room.
14.zh: 最近租金猛涨，学生很难找到房间。

28.en: It is a privilege to welcome visitors to our school.
28.zh: 能欢迎各位来访者来到我们学校，是一种荣幸。

35.en: An eminent scientist gave a talk at our school.
35.zh: 一位杰出的科学家在我们学校做了演讲。

41.en: The concert will commence at seven, so please arrive early.
41.zh: 音乐会七点开始，请提前到场。

47.en: The children stopped to marvel at the huge waterfall.
47.zh: 孩子们停下来，惊叹于这座巨大的瀑布。

55.en: The school delegates some tasks to parent volunteers.
55.zh: 学校把部分任务交给家长志愿者。

62.en: The office administers the scholarship program.
62.zh: 该办公室负责管理奖学金项目。

71.en: The headline was misleading and left out an important fact.
71.zh: 这个标题具有误导性，漏掉了一个重要事实。

77.en: The new guidelines explain how to borrow books online.
77.zh: 新指南说明了如何在线借书。
